idea: a paper crane delivering letters across rooftops at sunset
creator: Ahmed
title: Paperwing Post

design.title: Paperwing Post
design.tagline: Glide over sunset rooftops and deliver every letter with love.
design.story: Pippa the paper crane wakes when the sunset bell rings. The rooftop mail nests are empty, and friends are waiting for bedtime letters. With a satchel of folded wishes, she hops across chimneys, rides warm evening breezes, and bops grumpy soot-puffs aside to finish her route before stars appear.

hero.name: Pippa
hero.look: Tiny cream origami crane with folded triangle wings tipped in coral, black bead eyes, soft folded smile, rosy cheeks, mini kraft-paper mail satchel.

world.setting: Rolling townhouse rooftops with chimneys, clotheslines and water towers beneath a peachy sunset sky.

specialMechanic.name: Paper Glide
specialMechanic.howItWorks: Hold jump in mid-air to unfold wings and glide gently down; release to flap. Warm golden updrafts lift you higher while gliding for long sunset flights.

levels.name: Chimney Hop Row
levels.idea: Low cozy rooftops to learn running, hopping and gliding while collecting letters and bopping soot-puffs to the first nest.

levels.name: Bell Tower Updrafts
levels.idea: Higher gaps and tall towers where warm updrafts carry you across wide sky gaps to the moonlit grand nest.

sprites.name: hero
sprites.prompt: small origami crane folded from cream paper with coral-pink wingtips, sharp triangular wings, tiny round black eyes, gentle smile crease, light pink blush marks, small kraft paper satchel strap

sprites.name: enemy
sprites.prompt: round charcoal soot puffball with stubby feet, grumpy pouty eyes, dusty gray fuzzy texture, tiny rusty-red chimney-cap hat, puffed cheeks

sprites.name: enemy2
sprites.role: flying critter that drifts side to side
sprites.prompt: plump fluffy dusk-blue baby sparrow with round body, tiny fluttery wings, sleepy grumpy eyes, soft cream belly, small peach beak, ruffled feathers

sprites.name: collectible
sprites.prompt: small cream envelope sealed with coral heart sticker, soft paper texture, rosy blush edges, tiny folded wing illustration, warm golden glow

sprites.name: powerup
sprites.prompt: golden feather with soft fluffy barbs, coral wax seal stamp at quill base, warm honey glow, tiny sparkle dots, smooth curved shape

sprites.name: goal
sprites.prompt: cozy round bird nest woven from golden twigs and sunset-orange yarn, soft cream cushion inside, three tiny letters tucked in rim, warm lantern glow

sprites.name: tile
sprites.prompt: square block of dusky purple rooftop with rows of curved terracotta tiles on top edge, soft brick texture, tiny moss dots, warm sunset highlight

sprites.name: platform
sprites.prompt: narrow wooden plank ledge with woven rope edges, warm honey brown wood grain, small folded paper patch, hanging clothespin with tiny cream cloth

sprites.name: background
sprites.prompt: wide layered city rooftop silhouettes in dusky purple and soft mauve under peach to indigo gradient sky, round low sun, tiny glowing windows, distant bell tower, soft clouds, empty with no characters

sprites.name: updraft
sprites.prompt: vertical swirling column of translucent golden air with drifting amber leaves and soft sparkles, wispy warm curls, glowing edges

verdict.summary: You glide as a paper crane across sunset rooftops, collecting mail and dodging enemies.
verdict.seen: Screenshots show a sunset rooftop town with a paper-crane hero gliding, envelope collectibles, a round enemy, and readable star, hearts, and glide-tutorial HUD.

seasons.notes: Built Paperwing Post with paper-glide fall cap plus golden updraft lift columns and tailwind powerup across two sunset rooftop levels.
